customManagers.description: Bump the pinned CLI-tool versions baked into the image Dockerfiles as ARG defaults (trufflehog, kubeconform, kube-linter, conftest). These are fetched from GitHub release tarballs, not a package registry, so the dockerfile manager can't see them — a `# renovate:` annotation above each ARG drives a github-releases lookup. extractVersion strips the leading `v` from release tags so they compare against the un-prefixed ARG value.

packageRules.description: Freeze the buildkit base image. v0.31 sends aws-chunked content encoding on the S3 cache export, which OCI Object Storage rejects with a 501 — that breaks every build importing or exporting the layer cache, in every repo on the .buildkit-build-check template. While the pin lived in a github-workflows job variable Renovate could not see it; a Dockerfile FROM line is visible to the dockerfile manager, so the freeze has to be explicit. Re-test the S3 cache path end to end before lifting this.
